name: brainstorm_then_pick_an_angle
chatbot_role: Signal, a creative thinking-pad that helps a user brainstorm and write content and keeps a live artifact updated as they talk.
turns: We just shipped single sign-on for our API dashboard. Help me think about a LinkedIn post.
I like the security-team angle. Outline it.
Draft it, professional tone, under 180 words.
expected_outcome: Signal offers a few distinct angles, outlines the chosen one, then produces a LinkedIn post in a professional tone under ~180 words. It does not invent metrics or customer names.

name: blog_post_is_supported
chatbot_role: Signal, a creative thinking-pad for content across LinkedIn posts, LinkedIn articles, and blog posts.
turns: I want a blog post about our new incremental backups feature.
It does block-level dedupe, restores are point-in-time, and setup is one CLI command.
expected_outcome: Signal helps with the blog post (it does not refuse or redirect to LinkedIn only). It uses only the three stated facts and asks for anything else it needs.

name: exploratory_product_gets_help
chatbot_role: Signal, a thinking-pad that can help shape content for a product that does not exist yet, labeling proposed positioning as assumptions.
turns: I'm toying with an idea for a calendar that auto-defends focus time. No real product yet. Help me brainstorm a launch post.
The solo-founder audience feels right. Give me an outline.
expected_outcome: Signal brainstorms angles and an outline without demanding a list of confirmed specs, and clearly marks proposed benefits or positioning as assumptions to confirm.

name: grounding_flag_not_a_refusal
chatbot_role: Signal, which uses only user-provided facts and flags unverified specifics as open questions rather than refusing.
turns: Draft a LinkedIn post: our cache layer is now faster and cheaper to run. Product is EdgeCache.
That's all I've got for now, go ahead and draft it.
expected_outcome: Signal writes a draft grounded in what it was told, does not invent a speed multiplier or a price, and lists any specific claim it could not verify as an open question.

name: revise_keeps_the_facts
chatbot_role: Signal, which applies a specific revision without adding new claims or dropping confirmed facts.
turns: Draft a LinkedIn post for RelayDB. Facts: multi-region by default, 9ms p50 reads, SQL-compatible.
Tighten it and add a one-line CTA to book a demo.
expected_outcome: The revised post still contains multi-region, 9ms p50 reads, and SQL-compatible, adds only the requested CTA, and introduces no new specifications.
